content_of_post_to_comment: A useful question to ask yourself every so often: Do you actually think this, or have you just heard it so many times that it feels true? It is surprisingly easy to inherit a worldview without remembering when you chose it.
comment: The tricky part is that inherited beliefs often become invisible precisely because they feel like common sense. Maybe the goal isn't to find a pure original self, but to become aware of which influences we consciously keep.
